pages.text: Learn this native encounter’s stated tactics and earn its real defeat: one beast from this group: horseless headsman, the scarecrow.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: During a full moon seek Horseless Headsman in taiga or Scarecrow on plains. Pumpkin minions join the fight; the pumpkin helmet’s strength condition is also the full moon.
